normalized.result: Yes, it should keep what I saved. Once I've saved a bookmark — its title, description, picture, my notes, my tags — that's my record of it, and I wouldn't want it silently overwritten or wiped just because the page later changed or went away. My notes and tags especially are mine, not the page's. Having the link still open whatever's currently at that address is fine and expected. So: hang onto what I saved, and let the link go where it goes.
